name: tape
description: Real-time orderflow visualizer for crypto perpetual futures — umbrella package delegating to server/ (Elysia on Bun) and web/ (Next.js 15).

scripts.build: pnpm -F tape-server build && pnpm -F tape-web build
scripts.lint: pnpm -F tape-server lint && pnpm -F tape-web lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F tape-server typecheck && pnpm -F tape-web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -F tape-server test && pnpm -F tape-web test
